games.title: Sweetfang
games.description: Mochi is the sweetest little creature in the Meadow, until the Sour Meter fills. A hand-crafted side-scrolling adventure across 18 lands where every cute moment has a dark side. Fill the meter, unleash Fang, and fight your way to the heart of the Hollow.
features: 18 hand-crafted lands across two acts
Transform into Fang when the Sour Meter fills
Seven unforgettable characters and two endings
Play on keyboard, PlayStation or Xbox controller

games.title: LOW TIDE
games.tagline: Port Hollis, 1977. Three days to pay what you owe.
games.description: Ray Castell runs a fast boat out of Port Hollis, and he owes the Moretti crew fifty thousand dollars. Vic Sarno wants it paid by the third dawn. Run cargo past the Harbor Patrol, take side work on the docks, steal a car when you need one and buy guns from Augie under the counter. When the scanner lights up, the Patrol comes in waves, each one harder than the last: shoot your way out, lose them on the water, or go down fighting. A mini open-world crime story you finish in an evening, with two endings and a case file that grades how you did it.
features: A whole island harbor to run: drive the boat all the way round, walk the quay, take any car
Three days and nights, seven story jobs plus side work on the docks
A police scanner that escalates in waves: lose them, or wipe them out
Third-person gunfights with cover, grenades and Molotovs
Two endings and a graded case file at the end
An original 80s soundtrack and a fully voiced cast
Play on PlayStation or Xbox controller, or keyboard and mouse

minimum.storage: 12 GB free while installing (5 GB after)

recommended.storage: 12 GB free while installing (5 GB after), SSD

games.title: PIVOT!
games.tagline: Lift with your legs. Name with your heart.
games.description: Grandpa Gus left you his tiny moving company, one rusty truck and Earl, a large man who came with the business. Name your company, then haul couches, pianos, fish tanks and a whole lot of boxes before the clock runs out. Call the crew to lift the heavy stuff, keep the client's treasures in one piece, level up, buy bigger trucks, hire weirder movers and take on SwiftLift, the drone-powered moving app run by Chad.
features: Name your own moving company and paint the sign
9 story jobs plus endless gigs, from a frat house to a haunted mansion
Hire a crew of 8 oddballs who haul, lift, snack and trip on their own
4 trucks, 4 offices, contracts and perks to level up
Play on keyboard and mouse, PlayStation or Xbox controller

changes: Button prompts now match the controller you're holding: keyboard & mouse, Xbox (A B X Y LB RB) or PlayStation (✕ ○ □ △ L1 R1), switching live. New Settings option: Button prompts (Auto / Xbox / PlayStation) for Steam Input users. Includes everything in 1.1.0.

Big update: brand-new moving-day UI, new loading screens, full controller polish (PlayStation & Xbox prompts), GTX 1070-tuned graphics with Auto/Medium/High/Ultra + FSR 2, quieter customers, and a continue prompt in story scenes.
First release of PIVOT! on the HAMMS launcher
9 story jobs, endless gigs, 8 crew, 4 trucks, 4 offices
Fully voiced cast
Keyboard and mouse, PlayStation and Xbox controllers

games.title: Off The Books
games.tagline: Two dirty cops. One Klan house. No backup.
games.description: Dee and Don are brothers, adopted, and both dirty cops. The captain hands you the jobs off the books: gear up in your apartment, find the right house on a snowy street, take it apart, load the cash into the trunk and outrun every cruiser in town on the way home. Play it solo with your AI brother, together online, or head to head: one of you robs the house while the other one is the law.
features: Bodycam first-person gunplay with real bullet travel
Solo with an AI brother you command, or co-op online with a friend
Versus: one player robs the house, the other plays the cop sent to stop him
Car chases where you shoot back, get out, and get back in
Play on PlayStation or Xbox controller, or keyboard and mouse

minimum.gpu: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 5600 XT (6 GB)
minimum.storage: 30 GB free while installing (10 GB after)

changes: NO VACANCY rebuilt on PropHaus's own Paradise Motel example map: every building, walkway, the pool, reception and the parking bays as the pack's makers laid them out
Palm trees are winter maples, the outdoor tropical plants are gone, and there is no snow under the roofs and walkways
Room 209 is at the far end of the north building's top floor; 8 rooms you can go into; both flights of stairs walk smoothly
About fifteen cartel men, rifles up on the walkways, two night staff at the reception desk
LAST RIDE: trees no longer float, and there are no gunmen at the gate or the ticket booth
Phone and online calls, rebuilt:
The phone always comes up on screen. Pressing the button fast or twice no longer parks it below the screen
Controllers that Windows sees twice (DS4Windows, Steam Input, some Bluetooth pads) now open the phone properly
Second phone button: touchpad click (PlayStation), View (Xbox) or Tab. Options / Esc has a PHONE option too
Incoming calls start on ANSWER: Cross / A picks up, Circle / B declines
A call that comes in while a menu is open waits and pops up when you close it. A bar at the top says who is calling
The phone checks its own line every few seconds and reconnects by itself. Its signal bars show whether calls can reach you
The caller sees what is happening: CONNECTING, RINGING, HE'S AT THE MAIN MENU, HIS PHONE IS OFF, or WRONG UPDATE
After a friend's game dropped, the leader's phone used to say "busy" until a restart. Fixed
The captain's first call: hold Circle or use Options > END THE CALL to get your phone back
Your phone number and update show on the phone's home screen and in the pause menu

New mission: LAST RIDE. An abandoned amusement park held by a local crew. Clear it out and get the four bags off the roller coaster's platform. A loud shot starts a four-minute clock before the county sheriff arrives
New online mode: BAG RACE. One bag, a car each at opposite ends of the street. Shoot each other and respawn until someone drives off with it, then it's a chase to the drop-off with no respawns
Co-op: your partner can now get in the car and ride off with you, and bags he puts in the trunk count
Co-op: both games now have the cash in the same place (a bag one player took was not always taken for the other)
Co-op: a car with your partner already sitting in it is no longer thrown across the street when you take the wheel
Cops and Robbers: the robber now sees the law's partner climb into and out of the cruiser
The captain's call in the middle of a job no longer stands you still in a gunfight
Motel: the outside stairs lead onto the walkway properly, and reception is furnished
Both players need this update to play together
Online: in Cops and Robbers your partner now gets into the cruiser with you, rides beside you and gets out with you
Online: doors opened or kicked in by one player are now open for the other
Online: the other player, the people on the street and the other car move smoothly instead of lurching
Online: players take full damage from each other (the other player was three times too tough)
Online: a slow loading screen no longer drops the party
The captain's phone call no longer starts over every time you press Continue
Both players need this update to play together
New job: NO VACANCY. A cartel crew holds the Paradise Motel; the money is in Room 209 and a federal task force is ten minutes out
Six bags at the motel: two at a time to the trunk, as many trips as you dare
The apartment tablet now holds two contracts: L1 / R1 turns between them
Orders to your brother or partner are on R1 now (was L1)
Enemies and your brother take cover against walls, lean out, and react to being hit
Cars: wipers, horns, mirrors, cabin light, better pass-by and engine sound
Online: both games must be on d148
First release on the HAMMS launcher: solo, online co-op and versus
Getting out of a police car no longer spins your view
Police cars no longer fly into the air when the cops get out
Your brother gets back in the car right away when he's close
